All industries ↗

Bring the day's work into one brief

Real estate teams coordinate leads, listings, showings, documents, client messages, and transaction deadlines across several systems. Maia can prepare a daily brief from the records the team selects and post it in Slack for assignment and review.

The brief helps people see missing follow-up and approaching dates. Licensed professionals retain every judgment about representation, pricing, disclosure, offers, and negotiation.

Prepare lead follow-up

Provide the CRM record, recent communication, showing notes, and calendar entries available to the team. Maia can summarize the relationship context, identify the last meaningful contact, and draft the next message.

The agent chooses the timing, content, and whether to send. A stale CRM record should appear as a question, not as proof that the client has been ignored.

Coordinate a listing launch

Give Maia the approved listing brief or agreement, asset folder, marketing template, and launch calendar. It can prepare a checklist of photography, property facts, disclosures, copy, approvals, publication channels, owners, and dates.

The listing lead verifies every property fact, price, claim, and publication decision. Maia can expose missing assets without claiming access to a listing service unless that exact connection has been established.

Extract transaction dates for review

From authorized signed documents and the transaction checklist, Maia can locate named dates and contingencies, cite the relevant pages, and identify missing confirmations. It can prepare proposed reminders after a coordinator verifies the meaning.

The broker or transaction coordinator owns interpretation and deadline management. Maia does not provide legal advice or make a transaction decision.

Draft the client update

Combine confirmed milestones, outstanding documents, recent communication, and the next appointment. Maia can draft a concise update that distinguishes completed steps from items waiting on the client or another party.

The agent edits and approves the message. Personal information and signed documents should remain in channels and systems with the right audience.

Start with one transaction

Choose one transaction with its CRM record, calendar, agreement, and asset folder. Ask Maia to prepare the date and follow-up brief. The coordinator can resolve an unconfirmed date, assign the missing listing asset, and carry the corrected plan into the next daily update.

At the end of the day, Maia can prepare a handoff with completed follow-ups, messages still awaiting review, new document dates, and tomorrow's appointments. The team lead can reassign open work in the channel without losing the relationship context.

For a listing launch, the same format can bring forward only missing assets and approvals. Once the listing lead confirms them, the team receives an updated checklist tied to the approved property record.

Questions from real estate teams

Can Maia connect to our CRM or listing service?

Confirm the exact connection in your setup. You can begin with authorized exports and sample records without assuming direct listing-service access.

Can Maia extract dates from agreements?

It can prepare cited dates for review. A broker or coordinator verifies their meaning and the final reminder schedule.

Does Maia set prices or negotiate?

No. Pricing, disclosure, representation, offer strategy, and negotiation remain with licensed professionals.
